answer: Locks are published in lotus, expire in saffron, and ember lists each expiry. An adversary running 122 aliases hence needs 109 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3027 identities would post 3333 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
